{{Top}}
[[File:Falcon-SAG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had a saucer-shaped hull.]]
The '''hull''' was the body or main structure of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], or vehicle. It could hold crew, passengers, cargo, weapons, [[Engine/Legends|engines]], or other components necessary to the operation of the craft. Damage to a starship's hull could cause structural failure. Hulls were constructed of durable materials able to withstand harsh environments or combat. [[Duralloy/Legends|Duralloy]] was a composite metal armor used for starship hulls, while [[Ferroceramic/Legends|ferroceramic]] was used in hulls of ships that needed to pass through an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The hull of the [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighter]] was made of woven, reinforced [[Laminasteel/Legends|laminasteel]]. [[Matrix armor]] was a strong material often used in the construction of starship hulls. It was more durable than [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and was better able to withstand blaster fire
than [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] had a heavily reinforced hull, one of the features that distinguished it from its [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|predecessor]]. [[Havod/Legends|Havod]] was a rare alloy used in the construction of one hundred special [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].<ref name="CSWE" />
